'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[August 2024 Deir el-Balah attacks]]
****Eighteen people from the same family are killed in an [[airstrike]] in the town of [[Az-Zawayda]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-08-17-2024-07e5f3d968cb09613609eb1086e26e91 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ten-palestinians-killed-israeli-strike-central-gazas-zawayda-wafa-agency-says-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank during the Israel–Hamas war]]
***Two senior [[Hamas]] militants are killed in an [[Israel]]i airstrike in [[Jenin]] in the [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|occupied]] [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-airstrike-kills-least-two-palestinians-west-bank-health-ministry-says-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[Three-phase Israel–Hamas war ceasefire proposal]]
***[[Israeli system of government|Israeli officials]] state that they are attempting to "lower expectations" of a [[ceasefire]] deal due to significant gaps between [[Israel]] and [[Hamas]] demands, after [[United States president]] [[Joe Biden]] stated that he was "optimistic" about the progress of US-mediated negotiations in [[Qatar]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/17/israel-war-on-gaza-live-israeli-attacks-continue-as-focus-on-truce-talks?update=3123123 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2024 Kursk offensive]]
****Rockets launched by the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] destroy a [[Russia|Russian]] bridge over the [[Seym (river)|Seym river]] in [[Glushkovo, Glushkovsky District, Kursk Oblast|Glushkovo]], [[Kursk Oblast]]. [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russia's foreign ministry]] claims that the missiles were launched using [[Western world|Western]]-made [[rocket launcher]]s and that the missiles killed volunteers who were evacuating [[Russians|Russian civilians]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-ukraine-used-western-rockets-destroy-bridge-kursk-region-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Budget of Germany]], [[Germany–Ukraine relations]]
***[[Germany]] issues an indefinite ban on requesting or providing new [[Military aid|military aid]] to [[Ukraine]] that has not already been approved in order to reduce [[Budget of Germany|federal budget]] spending. The [[Moratorium (law)|moratorium]] results in a "tangible dispute" within the [[Scholz cabinet|Scholz coalition government]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-halt-new-ukraine-military-aid-report-war-russia/ (Politico)] [https://kyivindependent.com/germany-to-limit-new-military-aid-to-ukraine-faz-reports/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**[[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis]]
***The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] declares that the safety of the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] is deteriorating, following an investigation into an [[Drone warfare|explosive drone strike]] that targeted a perimeter access road at the power plant. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-accuses-ukraine-bombing-road-near-zaporizhzhia-nuclear-power-plant-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[August 2024 Nabatieh attack]]
***Ten [[Syrians in Lebanon|Syrian]] citizens, including two children, are killed in an [[Israel]]i airstrike on a residential building in [[Nabatieh]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/17/at-least-six-killed-in-latest-israeli-strike-on-southern-lebanon (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/six-killed-israeli-strike-lebanon-health-ministry-says-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)]
***[[Hezbollah]] reportedly strikes the [[Ayelet HaShahar]] kibbutz in [[Upper Galilee]], Israel, wounding two Israeli soldiers in retaliation. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/six-killed-israeli-strike-lebanon-health-ministry-says-2024-08-17/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2024 Mogadishu tea shop bombing]]
***At least 20 people are killed and ten others are injured in a bombing at a tea shop in [[Daynile District]], [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]]. [https://aussiedlerbote.de/en/over-a-dozen-lives-tragically-lost-in-a-terroristic-assault-in-mogadishu/ (Aussiedlerbote)] [https://www.idilnews.com/mogadishual-shabaab-ied-attack-kills-20-at-dayniile-cafe-dozens-injured-initial-reports/ (IDil News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Galgani massacre]]
***At least 85 people are killed in [[arson]] and [[looting]] attacks amid a rampage by [[Rapid Support Forces]] in the village of Galgani in [[Sennar State]], [[Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-rsf-village-galgani-0e63ef15da694a558934ad2b32d6cc9b (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Lebanese blackout]]
**The state electricity company of [[Lebanon]] [[Électricité du Liban]] runs out of fuel reserves and announces that it can no longer supply power to the country, leading to a complete nationwide [[power outage|blackout]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/08/17/lebanons-state-electricity-company-runs-out-of-fuel-sparking-blackout-fears/ (''The National'')]  [https://ina.iq/eng/34197-lebanon-without-electricity.html (Iraqi News Agency)]
*A 7.2-magnitude earthquake strikes off the eastern coast of [[Kamchatka Krai]], [[Russia]] with a tsunami warning being issued. [https://news.sky.com/story/7-2-magnitude-earthquake-strikes-off-russian-coast-tsunami-warning-issued-13197584 (Sky News)]
*A [[Fouga Magister]] aircraft operated by the [[French Air Force]] performing an [[air show]] crashes off the coast of [[Le Lavandou]], [[France]], killing the pilot. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/08/17/plane-crashes-into-sea-during-air-show-in-france (AFP via Euronews)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*Six people are arrested in connection to a [[mass shooting]] due to [[feud]]s that occurred last week in [[Clarendon Parish, Jamaica|Clarendon Parish]], [[Jamaica]], which killed eight people and injured nine others. [https://apnews.com/article/jamaica-mass-shooting-suspects-arrested-5f99fdd543effd3cdf100b4297554f35 (AP)]
*Four convicts escape in a prison break at a [[psychiatric hospital]] in [[Straubing]], [[Bavaria]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-4-escape-criminal-pyschiatric-facility-in-bavaria/a-69970390 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*For the first time, the [[Independence Day (Indonesia)|Indonesian Independence Day]] ceremony is held simultaneously in [[Jakarta]] and [[Nusantara (city)|Nusantara]] due to the [[Capital of Indonesia#Relocation to Nusantara|relocation of the country's capital]].
